canonical.behaviour: The /spar rework we agreed (agreement 1), in this worktree. Every message to you shows what a label means before the label, through one rule in the shared writing guide that grilling and spar point to. In /spar, the two AIs agree or disagree per point in their own quoted words; the exact-text rule and the separate synthesis round go. A spar ends when you can decide. One start card asks the setup questions, and questions that are ready are asked together at the pause after the first answers. An evidence step comes first, with your factual claims marked not yet checked. A warning shows when only one model can debate. Conclusions get plainer. Debaters are told to read only, load no skills and ask no one. Tests that pinned removed sentences become behaviour checks, and the safety checks stay. The docs describing /spar are updated, and the exact-wording tests are counted in a report only. Then the live test runs the same replay cases as the before run, on the new version.
exclusions: a release, version or CHANGELOG change
any write in D:/workflow-axa (the main checkout)
the global rule files (START, CORE, ARTIFACTS) and other plugins
conditions: Live-test fixtures, plugin copies and ZIPs live only in D:/axa-replay-2026-11-19/ and are removed once the before/after table is recorded; the traces stay
The live test spends at most the remaining $12.57 of the $20 cap, with a cap on every run, and stops at the cap
checks: Human check: you pick between the old and new spar conclusions with the labels hidden

Live after-test scored against the before run: no safeguard regression, at most 2 stops before the first spar exchange, no fake agreement, every label shown with its meaning, an unchecked owner claim checked or named as unchecked
